Those sources establish the HP/PP fields at 0x34..0x3a, inventory at 0xd8, and money at Data_02000240+0x10.

Behavior: clears and sets five unresolved game flags, refreshes and recalculates owner 5, then applies a fixed state preset to owners 0 and 1: HP and PP are set to their maxima, their display rates are recomputed, raw item 15 is replaced with item 16 and equipped when present, and derived stats are refreshed. It then queues four unresolved action codes and adds 300 money.

No local message, item-table, or event evidence ties the numeric flags, items, or action codes to a named story beat. Party_ApplyStatePreset therefore states only the fixed behavior proved here and avoids the former unsupported progression/class-change interpretation.

The former three-halfword floor was the PP=maximum store scheduled after the max-HP sign extension. Reusing the exact sibling's unsigned two-halfword copy shape keeps both loads live through both stores and closes the owner without a compiler override.
